title: TECR palmitoylation triggers a necrotic cell death program driving acute liver injury
title_zh: TECR酰基化诱导的坏死性细胞死亡程序驱动急性肝损伤
abstract: Acute liver injury caused by drug toxicity or immune activation remains a major clinical challenge with limited mechanistic understanding and few effective therapies. Here, we identify a previously unrecognized form of regulated cell death driven by palmitoylation of the endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-resident enzyme trans-2,3-enoyl-coenzyme A (CoA) reductase (TECR). We show that multi-site palmitoylation of TECR, redundantly catalyzed by the palmitoyl acyltransferases ZDHHC5 and ZDHHC2 and dynamically reversed by the depalmitoylase ABHD10, activates PERK-dependent ER stress signaling to trigger cell death. This cell death pathway is a TECR-dependent, palmitoylation-induced, ER stress-mediated necrotic cell death program (TPNCD). TPNCD contributes to liver injury in mouse models of acetaminophen- and concanavalin A-induced hepatotoxicity and is attenuated by hepatocyte-specific TECR ablation or by pharmacological inhibition of palmitoylation or ER stress signaling. Together, these findings establish TPNCD as a distinct, necrotic cell death pathway underlying acute liver injury and highlight new therapeutic entry points for hepatoprotection.
abstract_zh: 由药物毒性或免疫激活引起的急性肝损伤仍然是主要的临床挑战，机制理解有限，有效疗法稀少。本研究识别出一种由内质网（ER）驻留酶转-2,3-环氧化辅酶A（CoA）还原酶（TECR）酰基化驱动的此前未被认识的调控性细胞死亡形式。我们显示，TECR多位点酰基化经由酰基转移酶ZDHHC5和ZDHHC2冗余催化，并经由去酰基化酶ABHD10动态逆转，激活PERK依赖的内质网应激信号以诱导细胞死亡。该细胞死亡途径为TECR依赖、酰基化诱导、内质网应激介导的坏死性细胞死亡程序（TPNCD）。TPNCD在小鼠乙酰氨基酚和Concanavalin A诱导的肝毒性模型中导致肝损伤，并可通过肝细胞特异性TECR敲除或抑制酰基化或内质网应激信号来减轻。这些发现将TPNCD确立为一种独特的坏死性细胞死亡途径，潜在介导急性肝损伤，并突出了肝保护的新治疗靶点。
